title: After the Yasuda Kinen: A Triumphant Bath

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though disappointed by the loss, Ikuno Dictus takes inspiration from how Matikanetannhauser always tells herself, "Next time!" and looks steadfastly to the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afteward, she invites Matikanetannhauser to a bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time to fully recover and focus on the next race!
